1: Given the numbers $a=\dfrac{3\sqrt3-4}{1+2\sqrt3}$ and $b=\sqrt{27}\cdot\dfrac{(1/9)^3}{3^{-5}}$. a) Express the number a in the form $x+y\sqrt3$, where x and y are rational numbers. b) Write the number b as a power of 3 with a fractional exponent. c) The sum of the numbers a and b is 80% of a certain number c. Determine the number c.
2: After the news, TV station TVG will broadcast five commercials: three commercials for different washing powders and two commercials for different toothpastes. The order of broadcasting the commercials is chosen at random. Calculate the probability that two commercials for products of the same kind will not be broadcast directly one after another. Give the result as an irreducible common fraction.
3: The function $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ is given by the formula $f(x)=ax+4$. a) Determine the value of a for which the zero of function f is the number -1. b) Determine the value of a for which the line that is the graph of function f is inclined to the OX axis at an angle of 60°. c) Determine the value of a for which the equation $ax+4=2a+4$ has infinitely many solutions.
4: At a certain company, employees were classified into three pay groups. The number of employees and the monthly salaries (in euros) in each group are shown on a bar chart (salaries of 400, 480 and 540 euro). a) Determine the average monthly salary at this company. b) Calculate the variance and the standard deviation of the monthly salary at this company. Give the standard deviation to an accuracy of 0.1.
6: The graph shows a quadratic function f. Based on this graph: a) write, as a union of intervals, the solution set of the inequality $f(x)\le3$. b) determine and state the greatest and smallest value of function f on the interval $\langle0,3\rangle$. c) write the formula of function f in factored (product) form.
7: The sequence $(a_n)$ has general term $a_n=\dfrac{5-3n}{7}$ for $n=1,2,3,\dots$. a) Check, based on the definition, whether the sequence $(a_n)$ is an arithmetic sequence. b) Calculate for which value of x the numbers $a_4$, $x^2+2$, $a_{11}$ are consecutive terms of the same geometric sequence.
8: The height of a cylinder is 6 greater than the diameter of its base, and its total surface area is equal to $378\pi$. Calculate the volume of the cylinder.
10: In a trapezoid circumscribed about a circle, the angles at the longer base measure $60°$ and $30°$, and the height of the trapezoid is equal to 6. Make an appropriate drawing and label its elements. Calculate the area of the trapezoid and the lengths of its bases.
